{{Quote|I'm friendly with the Republic commander in charge of the blockade. I can get you in and out of the village.|Viidu|<ref name="Desperate Times" />}}
An individual served as the '''commander''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mantellian Army]] forces [[Blockade of Talloran village|blockading]] [[Talloran village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], during the [[Separatist War]] between the Republic-aligned [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. According to [[Viidu]], he and the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] were 'friendly'. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date Logic">{{TOR_dates|1}} As the conversation between Vididu and the player occurs during the Smuggler prologue, it can be inferred it takes place during 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> when Viidu [[Mission to Talloran village (Voidhound)|sent]] the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who would later be known as the [[Voidhound]] to Talloran village to meet with [[Reki]], he assured the smuggler that the Republic commander would let them in provided the smuggler [[Death/Legends|killed]] a few separatists.<ref name="Desperate Times" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic commander was first mentioned in dialogue between the player and Viidu in the Smuggler class mission "Desperate Times", in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Desperate Times" />
